content.short: Collector Crypt turns authenticated trading cards into TON NFTs that can be traded digitally or redeemed physically.
content.description: Collector Crypt is a collectibles platform focused on trading cards backed by physical inventory. According to its documentation, cards are authenticated, stored in secure vaults, and represented onchain as NFTs that users can buy, sell, or redeem for physical delivery. The product also includes a Telegram Mini App with pack openings, raffles, and marketplace activity, linking digital ownership on TON to the underlying collectible stored offchain while keeping the card redemption path intact for collectors.
content.meta: Collector Crypt links authenticated trading cards to redeemable TON NFTs.

resources.tldr: Every tokenised card can be withdrawn and shipped to you, which is the test of whether the token really represents the object.
